queue.title: Os juros futuros acentuaram a queda no fim da sessão e fecharam perto das mínimas do dia, acompanhando o tombo do petróleo e o maior apetite por risco no mercado externo, diante de notícias sobre um possível novo acordo de cessar-fogo entre EUA e Irã. No ambiente doméstico, o alívio nas taxas encontrou respaldo na volta do capital estrangeiro à bolsa e nos números da arrecadação federal, que atingiu R$ 289,346 bilhões em julho, com alta real de 8,97% na comparação anual, e acima dos 284,6 bilhões esperados pelos economistas. No fechamento, o DI para janeiro marcava 13,680% (de 13,701% no ajuste anterior); Jan/28 a 13,785% (13,883%); Jan/29 a 14,055% (14,174%); Jan/31 a 14,285%, na mínima do dia (14,421%); e Jan/33 a 14,390%, também na mínima do dia (14,514%). (*Téo Takar*)

queue.title: 2026 Best Cities for Work Revealed
queue.resumo: Indeed Hiring Lab measured 40 metrics across six pillars against hundreds of US metro-areas to determine which cities are the best for workers in 2026. Laura Ullrich, Director of Economic Research at Indeed Hiring Lab, explains that its not about where company's are headquartered or where its best to run a company, but where Indeed is seeing the most career dynamism and opportunity -- so the top cities for workers may surprise you. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Northrop CEO on Defense Spending, Golden Dome System
queue.resumo: Northrop Grumman Chair, CEO and President Kathy Warden discusses doing business with the Trump administration, working on the Golden Dome space defense system and how geopolitical tensions and active conflicts are fueling a global defense spending boom. She speaks with Bloomberg's Kailey Leinz at a Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)
